dedupe_keys.name: botswana department of water affairs water accounts and hydrological data reports

description: The Department of Water Affairs of Botswana lists forms and reports on a downloads page. Its data items are the Botswana Water Accounts for 2010/2012 and 2012/2014, the Botswana Water Accounting Report 2014/15, two policy briefs on the water accounts and on irrigation, and a hydrology situational report called Current hydrological Data. The page also carries the integrated water resources management and water efficiency plan reports of 2013, groundwater project reports and forms such as dam details and river draw-off forms. Coverage is Botswana. Access is free by direct download of PDF files, with no sign-in. Caveats: the server dates of the files read were November 2015 and April 2016, so the page is not maintained; the report contents were not opened. Simulation uses: water supply and use by source and sector for water balance and drought planning in a dry country. Related records: the Australian water account (data-abs-water-account-australia) and FAO AQUASTAT (data-fao-aquastat-main-database).
